title: Euro adopted (Italy among the first 11 members)
reference: Euro area member from 1999-01-01; banknotes and coins from 2002-01-01
what_it_changed: Fixed exchange rate with partners; lower interest rates and convergence of yields to Germany's until 2008

title: Bossi-Fini immigration law
what_it_changed: Links residence permits to a work contract; tighter expulsion rules; large regularisation in 2002

title: Biagi law: delegation for labour market flexibility
reference: L. 30/2003; implemented by D.Lgs. 276/2003 (10 Sept 2003, in force 2003-10-24)
what_it_changed: New atypical contracts (project work, staff leasing, on-call work); wider use of temporary jobs

title: Moratti school reform
what_it_changed: Reorganised school cycles and the secondary track system
sources: https://www.orizzontescuola.it/legge-28-marzo-2003-n-53/ (L. 53/2003 dated 28 March 2003, GU n. 77 of 2 April 2003)

title: Maroni pension reform
what_it_changed: Raises minimum retirement age for seniority pensions (to 60 from 2008, 'scalone'); semi-annual windows

title: Damiano welfare protocol: 'scalone' replaced by steps
what_it_changed: Gradual increase in retirement age (quotas) instead of the 2008 three-year jump
sources: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/2007/12/29/007G0266/CONSOLIDATED/20260101 (L. 247/2007 dated 24 December 2007, GU n. 301 of 29 Dec 2007, in force 1 Jan 2008)

title: Sacconi pension measures: windows and life-expectancy link
what_it_changed: From 2011 new accrual rules and a link of requirements to life expectancy starting 2013
sources: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/2010/07/30/010G0146/CONSOLIDATED/20130209 (DL 78 of 31 May 2010; L. 122 of 30 July 2010; art. 12 windows from 1 Jan 2011)

title: Gelmini university reform
what_it_changed: Reorganises governance, recruitment and funding of universities

title: Salva Italia decree (Monti): Fornero pension reform, IMU, austerity
reference: DL 201/2011 converted by L. 214/2011 (2011-12-22); requirements rise from 2012-01-01
what_it_changed: Higher retirement ages (66-67), contribution-based pensions for all, quota system ended; IMU on first homes reinstated

title: Constitutional balanced-budget amendment
what_it_changed: Writes budget balance and debt sustainability into the Constitution, in line with the Fiscal Compact

title: Fornero labour market reform
what_it_changed: Revised dismissal rules (art. 18) and contract types

title: Spending review decree
what_it_changed: Cuts to intermediate consumption and public sector costs; consolidation of agencies
sources: https://www.orizzontescuola.it/decreto-legge-6-luglio-2012-n-95/ (DL 95 of 6 July 2012; converted by L. 135 of 7 August 2012, GU n. 189 of 14 Aug)

title: ECB: 'whatever it takes' (Draghi)
what_it_changed: Marked the turn in euro-area sovereign spreads

title: ECB Outright Monetary Transactions programme
what_it_changed: Unlimited conditional purchases of short-term sovereign bonds; spreads fall

title: Anti-corruption law (Severino)
what_it_changed: Prevention plans, transparency, creation of anti-corruption authority duties

title: '80 euro' income tax bonus
what_it_changed: Tax credit for employees with low-middle incomes from May 2014
sources: https://www.dottrinalavoro.it/notizie-c/governo-d-l-n-662014-misure-urgenti-per-competitivita-giustizia-sociale (DL 66 of 24 April 2014, GU n. 95; converted by L. 89 of 23 June 2014)

title: Jobs Act enabling law
what_it_changed: Delegation for the open-ended 'tutele crescenti' contract and other labour reforms

title: Contract with increasing protections (Jobs Act) in force, with hiring relief
what_it_changed: New open-ended hires without reinstatement for economic dismissals; social-contribution relief for 2015 hires

title: ECB public sector purchase programme (QE) starts
what_it_changed: Large-scale sovereign bond purchases; yields compress

title: 'Buona Scuola' school reform
what_it_changed: Mass hiring of teachers, school autonomy, work-linked training

title: EU bank resolution rules (bail-in) applied
what_it_changed: Bondholders bear losses in failing banks; followed by rescues of Veneto banks and MPS in 2016-17
sources: https://www.consob.it/web/investor-education/in-caso-di-dissesto-di-una-banca (D.Lgs. 180 and 181 of 16 Nov 2015; bail-in applicable from 1 Jan 2016)

title: Public procurement code
what_it_changed: Replaced the 2006 code; ANAC oversight; later amended several times

title: Industria 4.0 plan (Calenda)
reference: Presented 2016-09-21 in Milan; budget law 2017 incentives (hyper-depreciation 250%, super-depreciation 140%)
what_it_changed: Tax incentives for digital machinery investment

title: Minniti-Orlando decrees on asylum and security
reference: DL 13/2017 converted by L. 46/2017 (2017-04-13); DL 14/2017 on urban security
what_it_changed: Faster asylum procedures, repatriation centres; agreements with Libya in 2017

title: Vaccination law (Lorenzin)
what_it_changed: Mandatory vaccines for school attendance

title: Dignity decree
what_it_changed: Limits on fixed-term contracts and renewals
sources: https://certifico.com/news/consumer/decreto-legge-12-luglio-2018-n-87 (DL 87 of 12 July 2018, in force 14 July; L. 96 of 9 Aug 2018, in force 12 Aug)

title: Salvini security decree
what_it_changed: Abolishes humanitarian protection; extends detention; limits reception

title: Mandatory electronic invoicing (B2B and B2C)
what_it_changed: Invoices cleared through the tax agency's platform; the VAT gap falls markedly

title: Regime forfettario threshold raised to EUR 65,000
reference: L. 145/2018 (budget law 2019); regime created by L. 190/2014
what_it_changed: Flat 15% tax for small self-employed up to EUR 65,000 of revenue

title: Anti-corruption law 'Spazzacorrotti'
what_it_changed: Tougher penalties and lobbying transparency rules
sources: https://www.ipsoa.it/documents/quotidiano/2019/01/31/legge-anticorruzione-norme-interesse-imprese (L. 3 of 9 Jan 2019, GU n. 13 of 16 Jan, in force 31 Jan 2019)

title: Quota 100 early retirement and Citizenship Income (reddito di cittadinanza)
what_it_changed: Retirement at 62 with 38 years of contributions (2019-21); means-tested minimum income

title: National COVID-19 lockdown
reference: DPCM 9 March 2020 extends the restrictions to the whole country
what_it_changed: Nationwide movement restrictions; GDP falls 8.9% in 2020

title: ECB Pandemic Emergency Purchase Programme
what_it_changed: Backstop for sovereign spreads during the pandemic

title: Rilancio decree: Superbonus 110% and tax-credit transfer
what_it_changed: 110% tax credit for energy and seismic works; credits transferable or as invoice discount; large capital transfers 2021-23
likely_indicators: gov_balance_pct_gdp; spend_nature D9PAY; spend_cofog GF06; gfcf_pct_gdp

title: Next Generation EU agreed by the European Council
what_it_changed: EUR 750bn recovery fund; Italy the largest beneficiary

title: Lamorgese decree on immigration and security
what_it_changed: Partly reverses the 2018 decree: special protection and reception system

title: Delegation law for the universal child allowance
what_it_changed: Delegation to merge child benefits into one universal allowance

title: Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR) submitted to the EU
reference: PNRR, approved by Council implementing decision 2021-07-13
what_it_changed: EUR 194.4bn (122.6bn loans, 71.8bn grants) tied to reforms and milestones, to 2026

title: EU Council approves the Italian PNRR
what_it_changed: Disbursement conditional on milestones in six-monthly instalments

title: Cartabia reform: criminal process delegation (and civil, L. 206/2021)
what_it_changed: Aims to shorten trials; criminal decree in force 2022-12-30
sources: https://www.giustizia.it/giustizia/page/it/pnrr_riforma_civile (L. 134 of 27 Sep 2021; L. 206 of 26 Nov 2021; D.Lgs. 150/2022 and 149/2022)

title: Universal single child allowance (assegno unico) in force
what_it_changed: Replaces tax deductions and several child benefits with one monthly allowance

title: Decree blocking Superbonus credit transfers
what_it_changed: Public bodies barred from buying credits; end of free transfers; Superbonus rate cut stepwise

title: Cutro decree on immigration (after the shipwreck)
what_it_changed: Harsher penalties for smugglers; restricts special protection; new entry quotas
sources: https://temi.camera.it/leg19/post/OCD15_14945/decreto-immigrazione-cd-cutro-vigore-conversione-norme-urgenti-del-dl-20-2023-che-prevede-misure-speciali-regolare-i-flussi.html (DL 20 of 10 March 2023; converted by L. 50 of 5 May 2023)

title: New public procurement code
what_it_changed: Replaces D.Lgs. 50/2016; transitional rules to 2023-12-31

title: Inclusion allowance replaces the Citizenship Income (from 2024-01-01)
reference: DL 48/2023; Citizenship Income ends 2023-12-31, inclusion allowance from 2024-01-01
what_it_changed: Narrower, categorical benefit; employability track

title: Tax reform delegation law
what_it_changed: Delegation to redesign personal and corporate taxation, VAT and procedures
